faqs.question: Will a charger or mouse work with any laptop brand?
faqs.answer: Our universal chargers and mice work across brands — check the specs on each listing for exact compatibility (e.g. connector tip size for chargers).

faqs.question: Do bags fit all laptop sizes?
faqs.answer: Each bag listing states the maximum screen size it fits. If you're unsure, send us your laptop's screen size on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with accessories?
faqs.answer: Chargers and mice carry a 6-month warranty; bags carry a 3-month warranty against manufacturing defects.
